title: Panmagic permutations and N-ary groups
summary: Panmagic permutations are permutations whose matrices are panmagic squares. Positions of 1-s in the latter describe maximal configurations of non-attacking queens on a toroidal chessboard. Some of them, affine panmagic permutations, can be conveniently described by linear formulas of modular arithmetic, and we show that their sets have remarkable algebraic properties when one multiplies three or more of them rather than just two.
